description: This PHP source file defines the TimestreamInfluxDBClient class, which extends the AwsClient class to interact with the Timestream InfluxDB service. It includes method annotations for various database operations such as creation, deletion, listing, tagging, and updating databases, along with their asynchronous counterparts.
